from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class CompanyInvestmentCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Investment activity cash flow data from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock code of the company")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period")
    investment_cash_flow_net_amount: float | None = Field(description="Net cash flow from investment activities in yuan")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Short excerpt from the document containing the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cash_flows: list[CompanyInvestmentCashFlow]
